card.text: Explore Demodokus in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Jupiter Trojan in the L4 leading cloud. Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Demodokus · DAMIT 3896 convex shape
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 37.63 km effective diameter (fit ±1.307 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). An alternative pole solution remains in the archive. Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation; grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: Demodokus · source-model radial height
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 18.815 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
